canada.summary: A significant overnight snowfall is making for a slippery morning commute on Calgary roads.

canada.title: Kimberley snow removal crews prepare for winter after losing 2 plows in fire last year
canada.summary: The mountain town of Kimberley, B.C., is preparing for the first big snowfall. But, after a fire tore through their storage facility that housed snow plows last year, they’ll be operating with less equipment than usual.

canada.title: Protesters gather outside Confederation Building as N.L. quickly moves bill banning flavoured vapes
canada.summary: Newfoundland and Labrador will give retailers at least six months from when the current sitting of the House of Assembly wraps up, but intends to see flavoured vape products removed from store shelves.

canada.title: Injuries reported after fire destroys Glace Bay building that housed pizza shop, apartments
canada.summary: A building on Commercial Street in Glace Bay, N.S., is on fire and has collapsed. Cape Breton Regional Police say there are multiple injuries stemming from the incident.

canada.summary: The first of three virtual public sessions was held on Tuesday night.

canada.title: Ontario Premier Doug Ford touts importance of joining economic forces with Quebec
canada.summary: Speaking at a business luncheon on Tuesday in Montreal, Ford argued a stronger partnership between Ontario and Quebec is more important than ever in the face of American tariffs.

canada.title: New Vancouver council to debate vacancy control, data centres and living wages
canada.summary: The first substantive meeting of the new-look Vancouver council will see motions proposing covered bus stops in the city, cracking down on data centres and even vacancy control.

canada.title: Toronto’s new council is meeting for the first time. Here's who is new and what to expect
canada.summary: Toronto's mayor and 25 councillors will take part in their first council meeting Wednesday, where they will swear an oath of office and Olivia Chow will make her first speech. There are seven new faces on the council floor this term.

canada.title: Q&A: Edmonton police chief wants funding boost to tackle complex cybercrimes

canada.title: Ottawa spent over $3M in connection with Bill 21 challenge
canada.summary: Bill 21 bans certain government employees in positions of authority from wearing religious symbols, while requiring anyone providing or receiving a government service to have their face uncovered.

canada.title: Sask. expands coverage for 2 drugs used to treat ovarian cancer
canada.summary: The drugs will be used for women who have stopped responding to platinum chemotherapy. The province estimates as many as 10 women will be eligible for the drug treatment each year.

canada.title: Snowfall set to interrupt Saskatchewan's relatively balmy November
canada.summary: Winter is finally arriving in Saskatchewan, starting with a snowfall warning for Maple Creek. Environment and Climate Change Canada issued the warning Tuesday afternoon, saying the snow is expected to begin overnight.

canada.title: Yukon government backs three new positions for territory's water board
canada.summary: The government also signed a renewed memorandum of understanding with the Yukon Water Board laying out both parties’ responsibilities and commitment to work together.

canada.title: Wait for the most common diagnostic scans in Manitoba 'worse now than it ever has been': doctor

canada.title: Victoria Hospital Foundation raising money to bring uterine fibroid treatment to Manitoba
canada.summary: A Winnipeg hospital foundation is raising money so the facility can perform a minimally invasive treatment for a condition most women will develop by the time they hit menopause.

canada.title: Patient numbers, poll data both improve for Holt Liberals
canada.summary: Premier Susan Holt’s focus on health care may be starting to pay dividends for patients and for her own political fortunes.

canada.title: Rick Hansen is still the Man in Motion, 40 years later
